output.mapping: Lowercase rx/ry/rz are beam-anchor relative position in aircraft/body axes, not deflection after sag subtraction or sensor-axis components.

smallest_candidate.target_mapping: All three lowercase body-relative anchor positions at the original Sensor station, no sag subtraction or absolute-value transform. Half-last-place from each original token.
smallest_candidate.proposed_capability_boundary: Explicit source-position output support may defer construction of an undefined triad while preserving original Sensor records, anchor location and source bytes. Keep sensor-axis/attitude/flow/feedback outputs unavailable or reject their use; audit serialization, geometry and dynamic/control consumers. This is current scoped semantics, not historical parser compatibility proof.
historical_unknowns: Actual producing executable/build (driver names Aswing_R_5_98 but binary is absent).
Autoload/startup atmosphere, speed, frame/gravity direction, core/aero mode and solver continuation. The driver selects anchored defaults but no explicit !V, pose or .set is retained.
Exact historical NODE I100 node placement. A current mesh is a declared reconstruction.
Exact byte identity at generation. Retained producer final mass/adder agrees but no run transcript or per-run source hash exists.
smallest_candidate.next_scope: After independent semantic review and tests, one unchanged-source mounted structural comparison with all three outputs and explicit current assumptions; preserve mismatch rather than selecting axes or settings to improve it.

source_facts.fact: Section10.2 samples relative position r_i at the beam attachment. The triad is defined separately in section10.3; undefined Vspec/Aspec need not mathematically invalidate r_i.
Pylon position uses the undeformed pylon vector and beam rotation. Vspec/Aspec enter the separate sensor-axis transformation; they do not enter position.
GPS position and velocity do not depend on sensor orientation.

r is relative position in aircraft axes. Current guide sensor selector35/36/37 differs from original driver28/29/30; original saved rx/ry/rz headers determine this target mapping, not present menu numbers.
Global information blocks terminate with End. No reviewed source establishes implicit EOF termination for an empty Engine block.
Columns are named and scaling applies to data values. No reviewed source identifies an intended surplus-scaler deletion or shift.
Supplied parallel Vspec/Aspec make the cross-product triad undefined. Omitted-vector defaults are not a rule for replacing explicitly supplied parallel vectors.

MODE perturbs the previously computed nonlinear OPER state; F toggles free-body/vacuum. Eigenvalue imaginary part is frequency and real part damping/growth. Native components remain required, including real-only roots.

Report describes natural [45/0]3a twist, static measurement0.5m from clamp and tip load0.56m from clamp. Literal t=-.22 measurement and-.28 load relative to clamp+.28 agree with these distances; no sensor relocation is justified.

Final [45_0]_3a loop ends at mass0.4 and calls change_mass2 with twist adder0, then same-name driver and table. This matches retained mass and additive twist line while retaining original110/45-degree twist endpoints. It supports a declared last-state pairing, not proof of historical byte identity.
Generator replaces the Weight data row and twist transform line. It neither repairs Sensor axes nor introduces an End, nor modifies stiffness or baseline twist endpoints.

Null-object support filters Weight records only. Five modal models have exactly zero physical Weight but valid endpoint anchors; five other models have nonzero tip mass. The Sensor frames, EOF blocks and extra scalers remain separate.

Current validation builds the triad before accepting a model; measurement also builds it before independent position fields. A position-only capability would need explicit separation and null/error propagation for axis-dependent outputs, not fabricated axes.
Workbench attachment rendering also constructs sensor axes; any scoped output support must preserve point/pylon geometry without inventing triad arrows.

models.null_point_change_effect: Active tip mass remains physical; null-object support does not apply.
Zero Weight already lies within beam domain; null-object support removes none of the Sensor, Engine grammar or scaler blockers.

new_findings_beyond_previous_audit: Current null Weight support does not unblock any of the ten literal models: all Sensor frames still undefined, and null modal weights already have valid anchors.
Recovered all27 native files and197 stored targets, including25 real-only roots, instead of treating only four oscillatory modal values as the denominator.
The only clean-block/clean-scaler model, static[45_0]_3a, has a direct shell output and compatible retained MATLAB final state; body-position semantics do not depend mathematically on sensor axes.
Lowercase rx/ry/rz outputs are body-relative anchor positions, distinct from Earth/GPS outputs and postprocessed sag-subtracted absolute plots.
Four modal drivers share sensor.txt; static[0_90]_3s driver writes beam.txt; five native files remain shared or not named by retained output commands.

Modal post_traitement.m hardcodes[0_90]_3s imaginary values36.084607,226.50233,495.93867,636.74724,725.66549, while same-name retained native file starts5.5878486,13.199794,66.919806,365.02505. Do not substitute postprocessed values or assume they share a state.
Modal[45_0]_s has no retained same-name shell/native file and has a literal negative mg multiplier; no sign repair is justified.
Mesh drivers do not invoke MODE F, whereas four modal drivers do. Without recovered startup/toggle state, do not declare every mesh eigenvalue a conservative vacuum root.
qualifications: Single retained write name binds command paths, not complete historical state or source bytes at generation.
Retain all source tokens and roots. Half-last-place stored-target diagnostics do not justify running blocked inputs or create an acceptance threshold for unresolved settings.
The197 native scalars exclude any additional source-labelled script arrays and undecoded plot series. All61 output candidates remain visible; this is not a whole-family target-total claim.
Static plots subtract each sweep baseline and use absolute values; raw native position targets do not.
No missing-End insertion, Sensor relocation/default-axis substitution, surplus-scaler truncation, stiffness/mass fit or target deletion was performed.
